tools.name: atlas_search_templates
tools.description: Search the independent GBotRanked index by text, category, source, decision or minimum score.

tools.name: atlas_get_template
tools.description: Return one indexed template with source evidence and the complete score breakdown.

tools.name: atlas_compare_templates
tools.description: Compare up to five templates using the same versioned GBotRanked rubric.

tools.name: atlas_get_top_templates
tools.description: Return the highest-scoring indexed templates, optionally within one category.

tools.name: atlas_get_new_templates
tools.description: Return templates ordered by their recorded link-check date.

tools.name: atlas_explain_score
tools.description: Return the score decision, dimension breakdown, evidence, gaps and critical flags for one template.

tools.name: check_bot
tools.description: Check one https://x.ai/bot/<id> share link. Returns the indexed template if listed; otherwise a provisional, unreviewed v2 score from the public share page only. Never lists or publishes anything.
